topics.title: Radio Host Discusses Film Nominations, Prostitution in France
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, the host discusses film nominations while referencing actors Robert Duval and Bobby De Niro. The conversation then shifts to an explanation of legal prostitution in France alongside speculation about a potential modeling/actress ring involving wealthy individuals.

topics.title: De Niro, Day Linked French Investigation
topics.summary: The broadcast details an investigation involving Robert De Niro and Bobby Day regarding potential prostitution activities in France. Diane Zamora is implicated in accusations of involvement with the death of a man who was a rival for her boyfriend’s affections.

topics.title: Sarah Graham Testifies About Adrian Jones Murder
topics.summary: During the trial, Sarah Graham testified that her fiancé, David Graham, killed Adrian Jones. Subsequently, Sergeant Major Jean McKinney faced a military trial concerning accusations of sexual harassment against him and several women in his office.

topics.title: Lewinsky Testimony and Immunity Discussions
topics.summary: The conversation centers around the planned testimony of Monica Lewinsky before the grand jury, alongside her mother’s previous testimony. Legal counsel discusses potential immunity deals offered by William Ginsburg and Kenneth Starr amid concerns about Lewinsky's cooperation.

topics.title: ABC Announces 'TV Ticker' Return
topics.summary: 'TV Ticker,' starring Richard Lewis and Kevin Nealon, will return to ABC on March 6th at 9:30 AM. The sitcom is replacing ‘Teen Angel’ in the TGIF lineup after a reported unsuccessful season.

topics.title: Sinatra Hospitalized for Routine Tests
topics.summary: Frank Sinatra was admitted to a hospital for routine medical testing, occurring nearly a year after his heart attack. The hosts discussed concerns about his health and referenced ongoing legal proceedings involving Reverend Sharpton.
